# GetMedia

> GetMedia is a free, open-source Windows desktop app to download videos and audio from YouTube and other sites, powered by yt-dlp and ffmpeg.

## Official links

- Website: https://getmedia-app.vercel.app
- English: https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/en
- Português (Brazil): https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/pt-BR
- Español: https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/es
- Latest release (direct .exe download): https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda/GetMedia_Desktop/releases/latest
- GitHub repository (desktop app): https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda/GetMedia_Desktop
- GitHub organization/author: https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows only (installer is a single .exe)
- License: MIT
- Download libs: yt-dlp (https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) and ffmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org)
- Supports YouTube and other sites supported by yt-dlp
